title.en: Diplomacy arranged as a group portrait

alt.en: A framed engraving groups formally dressed men around a table, surrounded by portrait medallions and heraldic emblems.
alt.zh: 装框版画将礼服男子安排在桌旁，四周环绕肖像圆章与纹章。

caption.en: Jean Godefroy after Jean-Baptiste Isabey, Congress of Vienna, 1819 engraving; Wien Museum 88745/1.
caption.zh: 让·戈德弗鲁瓦据让-巴蒂斯特·伊萨贝原作，《维也纳会议》，1819年铜版画；维也纳博物馆88745/1。

interpretation.en: Made after the 1814–1815 negotiations, this composed group portrait presents diplomacy through people, rank and emblems.
interpretation.zh: 这幅群像作于1814—1815年谈判之后，通过人物、位次与徽记呈现外交。

note.en: The official Wien Museum item page explicitly marks this image CC0 and permits reuse, including commercial use.
note.zh: 维也纳博物馆官方单件页面明确将此图像标为CC0，允许包括商业用途在内的再利用。

transformation.en: Official image saved unchanged, including frame or margins where present.
transformation.zh: 原样保存官方图像，包括原有画框或纸边。

title.en: A church becomes a parliamentary chamber

alt.en: A coloured print shows curved rows of deputies below crowded galleries, with flags and drapery framing the central platform.
alt.zh: 彩色版画中，议员席呈弧形排列，上层旁听席坐满人，旗帜与帷幔环绕中央讲台。

caption.en: Eduard Gustav May after Franz Bamberger, Frankfurt assembly chamber, 1848; coloured lithograph, published by S. Schmerber, Wien Museum 87459.
caption.zh: 爱德华·古斯塔夫·迈据弗朗茨·班贝格原作，《法兰克福议会会场》，1848年；彩色石版画，S.Schmerber出版，维也纳博物馆87459。

interpretation.en: Curving rows of seats, galleries and national colours frame the assembly as a public institution. The image records a visual presentation of parliamentary life.
interpretation.zh: 弧形座席、旁听廊与国族色彩，把议会呈现为公共机构。图像保存了议会生活的一种视觉表达。

alt.en: A pale sepia photograph shows an open square before arcaded buildings, a tall entrance and a domed mosque with minarets.
alt.zh: 淡棕色照片中，空旷广场前排列连拱建筑，后方有高入口、圆顶清真寺与宣礼塔。

caption.en: Luigi Pesce, Yran, Piazza a Isphaan, 1858; salted-paper print from a paper negative, Met 67.606.14.
caption.zh: 路易吉·佩谢，《伊斯法罕广场》，1858年；纸负片盐纸照片，大都会67.606.14。

interpretation.en: This is an actual nineteenth-century photograph of the square, more than two centuries after Abbas’s capital project. It records later surviving architecture, not its original construction.
interpretation.zh: 这是广场的十九世纪实拍照片，距阿拔斯迁都工程已逾两个世纪，记录的是后世存留建筑，而非初建过程。

note.zh: 大都会官方单件页面将此图像标为公共领域；保存的单件API亦确认isPublicDomain=true。

title.en: Translated medicine becomes an illustrated book
title.zh: 译本医学成为图文书籍

alt.en: Arabic text surrounds a coloured scene with jars on a shelf and figures beside a large vessel over a fire.
alt.zh: 阿拉伯文环绕彩绘场景：架上排列陶罐，人物站坐于火上大锅旁。

caption.en: Preparing Medicine from Honey, Arabic Dioscorides manuscript, 621 AH/1224 CE, attributed to Baghdad; artist ʿAbdullah ibn al-Fadl, Met 57.51.21.
caption.zh: 《用蜂蜜制药》，阿拉伯文迪奥斯科里德斯手稿，伊历621年／公元1224年，归于巴格达；画家阿卜杜拉·伊本·法德勒，大都会57.51.21。

interpretation.en: This later copy shows the continuing life of translated medical knowledge. Its maker is not the original translator, and the image illustrates preparation rather than documenting a named patient.
interpretation.zh: 这份后世抄本展示译介医学知识的延续生命。制作者并非原译者，图像表现制药过程，而非记录某位有名患者。
